title: Production-build local navigation HTTP and rendered-HTML checks

method.client: Python urllib and HTMLParser; no browser automation
method.scope: Four new hubs in all five locales, all their internal anchor links and routes including header and reference detail pages, all 38 prior menu targets in all five locales, and epistemology AboutTabs/current section.
method.renderedChecks: Visible text excludes script/style hydration payloads. Claim IDs are compared to explicit ClaimRef IDs in source and to the current claim registry. Reference IDs must exist; unknown rendered reference statuses fail. Fragment identifiers must exist in the fetched target HTML.
method.limits: No external research URLs fetched. This checks production HTML and HTTP destinations; interactive behavior and visual layout are covered separately by browser QA.
